strings.about_dedicated: In AI mode the module takes over the phone app, silences the ringer and turns on Do Not Disturb, so a spare phone works best. To use the phone normally for a while, turn off the switch at the top.
strings.about_legal: Laws on recording calls and on telling callers that they are talking to an AI differ from place to place. Following them is your responsibility.
strings.about_rollback: To remove Bageo completely, first turn off the switch at the top (back to a normal phone), then disable or remove the module in Magisk or KernelSU and restart the phone.
strings.check_priv_missing: Installed as a normal app (%1$s). Flash the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU and reboot. If you also installed the APK by hand, uninstall that copy.
strings.check_priv_title: Installed as a privileged system app
strings.check_privperm_desc: Granted by the module at boot. They cannot be granted from this screen.
strings.check_uplink_idle: Not visible right now. On some phones it only appears during a call; the app notifies you if injection fails.
strings.check_uplink_missing: Needs the module: the MODIFY_PHONE_STATE permission is missing.
strings.check_uplink_title: AI voice injection into the call
strings.confirm_ai_body: This phone becomes an AI answering phone: calls no longer ring and the AI picks them up. Google Phone is turned off and Do Not Disturb is turned on.
strings.confirm_normal_body: Calls will ring and you answer them yourself. The AI will no longer answer calls on this phone.
strings.connection_hint_usb: USB (default, recommended): keep ws://127.0.0.1:8765. The PC program forwards this port over the USB cable with adb reverse automatically.
strings.connection_hint_wifi: Wi-Fi: enter the address shown by the PC program, for example ws://192.0.2.10:8787/ws?token=… The phone and the PC must be on the same network.
strings.grant_perms: Allow the requested permissions, then tap Start service again.
strings.header_compat: Tested on Pixel 7, 7a, 8 and 9. Other rooted phones may work; try at your own risk.
strings.ip_code_hint: Get it on the System page of the web console
strings.ip_err_address: Enter Bageo's IP address, for example 192.168.1.20.
strings.ip_err_busy: Too many wrong codes. Wait a minute and try again.
strings.ip_err_code: The pairing code is wrong or has expired. Get a new one in the web console.
strings.ip_err_unreachable: Can't reach this address. Make sure the phone and Bageo are on the same network.
strings.ip_err_wifi_off: In the web console, turn on "Phones can also connect over Wi-Fi" first.
strings.mode_err_busy: The previous switch has not finished yet.
strings.mode_err_dialer: The default phone app could not be changed.
strings.mode_err_dnd: Do Not Disturb could not be changed.
strings.mode_err_dnd_mode: Do Not Disturb is still on. On the phone, open Settings → Modes and turn off “%1$s”.
strings.mode_err_in_call: A call is in progress; hang up first.
strings.mode_err_no_root: The Bageo module is not running. In Magisk or KernelSU, check that the Bageo Uplink module is enabled, then restart the phone.
strings.mode_err_save: The mode could not be saved.
strings.mode_err_screening: The call screening setting could not be changed.
strings.mode_err_volume: The ringer volume could not be set.
strings.mode_failed: The switch did not finish. %1$s You can try again.
strings.mode_switch_hint: Turn it off to use this as a normal phone: calls ring and you answer them yourself.
strings.msg_no_browser: No app on this phone can open web pages.
strings.msg_perm_settings: Some permissions can no longer be requested here. Allow them on the app's system settings page.
strings.msg_url_invalid: The address must start with ws:// or wss:// and include a host.
strings.msg_url_saved_pending: Saved. To use the new address, tap Stop service and then Start service when no call is in progress.
strings.msg_url_saved_restarted: Saved. The service was restarted to use the new address.
strings.msg_wifi_forgotten: Wi-Fi connection forgotten. Connect the USB cable once to set it up again.
strings.notification_text_armed: Ready. Waiting for calls; the phone stays silent.
strings.notification_text_in_call: The AI is handling a call.
strings.notification_text_normal: Normal phone: calls ring and you answer them yourself.
strings.perm_answer_calls: Answer calls: pick up and hang up automatically
strings.perm_modify_phone_state: Send the AI voice into the call
strings.perm_read_call_log: Call log: read the caller's number
strings.perm_read_phone_state: Phone: know when a call starts and ends
strings.route_custom: Connected to the address you entered.
strings.st_ai_on: The AI is answering your calls
strings.st_ai_on_d: Incoming calls are answered by the AI. The phone stays silent.
strings.st_legacy_off: The old “AI answering” switch was off on this phone. Since this update the switch above decides: the AI now answers calls here. Turn it off to keep this a normal phone.
strings.st_normal: Normal phone: calls ring as usual
strings.st_normal_d: The AI does not answer. You answer calls yourself, like on any phone. Turn on the switch below to let the AI answer again.
strings.st_offline: Not connected to the computer yet
strings.st_offline_d: Check that Bageo is running on the computer, and that the phone is plugged in by USB or on the same Wi-Fi (plug it in by USB once first to pair).
strings.st_service_off: The answering service is not running
strings.st_service_off_d: Tap Start to run it again.
strings.st_steps_d: Finish the setup steps below so the AI can answer calls.
strings.st_switching_d: This usually takes a few seconds.
strings.step_battery_desc: Stops Android from closing Bageo to save battery, so no call is missed.
strings.step_battery_title: Do not let Android put Bageo to sleep
strings.step_dialer_desc: So the phone shows no call screen while the AI talks.
strings.step_dialer_title: Make Bageo the default phone app
strings.step_dnd_desc: Keeps the phone quiet while the AI answers.
strings.step_dnd_title: Let Bageo control Do Not Disturb
strings.step_module_missing: Flash the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU, then restart the phone.
strings.step_pair_ip: Can't plug in USB (for example, Bageo runs in Docker): get a pairing code in the web console, then tap "Connect by IP address".
strings.step_pair_missing: First time: turn on USB debugging and plug the phone into the computer running Bageo. After pairing once, it also connects over Wi-Fi.
strings.step_pair_ok: Paired with the computer. Calls keep working over Wi-Fi when unplugged.
strings.step_pair_title: Plug into the computer by USB to pair
strings.step_perms_desc: Needed to notice calls, pick them up and send the call audio to the computer.
strings.step_perms_title: Allow Bageo to use the phone and microphone
strings.step_screening_desc: So incoming calls do not ring.
strings.step_screening_title: Make Bageo the call screening app
strings.test_fail_auth: refused: the token in the address is missing or wrong
strings.test_fail_network: this address cannot be reached. Are the phone and the computer on the same network?
strings.test_fail_refused: the computer refused the connection. Is Bageo running there, and is the USB link set up?
strings.test_fail_rejected: something answered, but it is not Bageo or it refused the connection
strings.uplink_missing_text: The call audio path is not available. Make sure the Bageo module is installed and enabled, then reboot.
strings.uplink_missing_title: The caller cannot hear the AI
strings.wifi_not_ready: Wi-Fi backup is not set up. Connect the USB cable once to set it up.
strings.wifi_ready: Wi-Fi backup is ready. Calls keep working if the USB cable comes out.
